title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: Binding a Quoted Cover and Its Insured Value
content:
A quoted cover of `Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims` becomes a cover in force when it is bound. This reference states what binding decides about the insured value and how the desk carries it out.

## The insured value on binding

A quote under the declared value tier or under one of the CargoCare products is bound on the cover holder's instruction, and binding sets its insured value at what the commercial invoice puts on the goods the cover extends to. Whatever figure the quote showed was a first estimate only; binding substitutes the bound value for it.

The rule speaks to covers whose premium falls due once they are in force. A cover held by a cash-in-advance customer under a tier with compulsory prepayment, where the premium has to reach the line ahead of binding, is not governed by it. For every cover it does govern, the remaining binding conditions keep their full force, among them the deadline reckoned back from the scheduled departure date and the exclusion of CargoCare binding for a holder whose credit is on hold.

## Capability of the tool

`bind_cargo_cover_f980fecc` puts a quoted cargo cover in force on its shipment and records the insured value at which it is bound. In one call:

- the cover passes from quoted to active;
- the binding is dated today;
- the bound insured value takes the place of the figure the quote carried.

The call neither books a premium nor takes a payment. The holder can afterwards be told that the cover is in force, the date of binding and the value bound.

## Invocation

The tool is operated on the agent's side: the desk agent unlocks `bind_cargo_cover_f980fecc` and calls it at the cover holder's instruction.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `cover_id` | the quoted cover to be bound, from the cover lookup | identifier |
| `booking_id` | the booking of the shipment the cover will attach to, from the booking lookup or as the cover shows it | identifier |
| `customer_id` | the cover holder, from the customer profile lookup | identifier |
| `insured_value_usd` | the insured value at which the cover is bound | US dollars, above zero, two decimals; kept rounded to the cent |

## Return

A successful call returns `status` "bound", `cover_id`, `cover_status` showing active, `bound_date` in the form YYYY-MM-DD, and `insured_value_usd`, the value bound, in US dollars to two decimals.
